text:
tom: hey team 👋 new hire here (Tom). I'm trying to follow the observability checklist but getting 403 on Grafana and 'no org membership' on Sentry. Datadog loads but shows empty folder. who handles the onboarding ACLs?

devex: welcome Tom! Glad you're here. Can you confirm you're using your work account tom@redwood.ai and logged in through Okta SSO?

tom: yep tom@redwood.ai and Okta shows me as logged in. Grafana immediately 403 after SSO redirect.

irene: hi Tom, i'll take this. two quick things: 1) try clearing cookies or incognito, 2) if still 403 i'll add you to eng-observability (read-only).

tom: tried incognito, still 403.

irene: thanks. filing a fast access request now. ops-bot: created request ACCESS-1192 for tom@redwood.ai -> groups: eng-observability, datadog-read. ETA ~45m.

ops-bot: ACCESS-1192 assigned to infra-admin. Link: https://id.redwood.ai/tickets/ACCESS-1192

infra-admin: looking. sometimes the Okta attribute 'team' was missing on new hires and Grafana blocks org mapping. i'll run the attribute sync and re-invite.

tom: appreciated. curious which dashboards are helpful to skim first as an SRE-ish new join?

irene: start with Grafana pane 'serving:overview' and the Datadog folder 'runtime/overview' — they show latency, token throughput, and recent errors. jess can DM links.

jess: sent links to Tom with short notes.

infra-admin: sync done, re-invited Tom to Grafana org. try in 3m and report back.

tom: can open Grafana now, Datadog folder visible, Sentry still shows pending invite.

irene: Sentry invite resent. once accepted you'll have project-level read permissions; ping if you need alert access.

tom: accepted. everything's visible. thanks for the quick help everyone! :tada:
